test_rolling_window_aggregation: test the DataFrame.rolling method to perform time-based and integer-based rolling window aggregations with sum, min, and max
test_rolling_group_by: test the DataFrame.rolling method with group_by parameter to compute rolling aggregations within grouped partitions
test_rolling_negative_offset: test the DataFrame.rolling method with negative offset to exclude the current row from the rolling window
test_rolling_window_boundaries: test the DataFrame.rolling method with offset and closed parameters to configure inclusive window boundaries
test_series_rolling_operations: test Series.rolling_sum, rolling_var, rolling_mean, and rolling_max methods with various window sizes and min_samples
